Lyft’s Bookings Rise on Strength in Partnerships, New Products

However, the ride-hailing platform’s top and bottom lines were dented by legal, tax and regulatory reserve changes and settlements

By

Lyft’s LYFT 2.34 % increase; up pointing triangle quarterly bookings rose, as its roster of partnerships and newer offerings helped it notch all-time highs for rides and riders, according to its finance chief.

“We really saw strength across the board, and that is a function of our partnership approach [and] product innovation,” Chief Financial Officer Michael Brous said in an interview.
